whatItIs.statement: Adds addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

whenToUse.statement: Use Input Group when an input or textarea needs adjacent icons, text, actions, loading state, or helper content within one visual control.

howToUse.statement: Place InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea before InputGroupAddon in the DOM for focus navigation; use align to change only the visual position.
For custom controls, set data-slot="input-group-control" so group focus, invalid, and addon-focus behavior can target the control.
Use inline-start or inline-end addons with InputGroupInput and block-start or block-end addons with InputGroupTextarea.

Inside Field, place InputGroup as a direct child and put the id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required, and disabled on InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea so FieldLabel and FieldDescription resolve to the control.
Give an icon-only InputGroupButton an aria-label; it defaults to type="button" so an inline action such as Show/Hide password does not submit a surrounding form unless type="submit" is set.

options.statement: InputGroupAddon align supports inline-start, inline-end, block-start, and block-end.
InputGroupButton supports xs, sm, icon-xs, and icon-sm sizes and defaults to the ghost variant.
